title: Student Bookings: shared list by default
lede: Students now open the Bookings tab on the same team-visible read surface as staff and admins, while the existing Mine control and ownership-based actions remain intact.

stats.n: Avery Nakamura and Jordan Lee appear in the shared list

sections.heading: The Bookings tab
sections.note: Captured through the real native view against the same fixture, with the simulator clock held at 09:42 and list timestamps anchored to the same hour.

pairs.title: Student default scope
pairs.sub: Look at the Active count, the person filter icon, and the owners named on each row.
pairs.beforeCap: Mine was the default: one row owned by Rowan Diaz.
pairs.afterCap: All is the default: the same row plus two team bookings, with Mine still available.

changes.was: Students landed on their own active bookings, so the Bookings tab did not match the shared operational view used by staff and admins.
changes.now: Students land on All visible active bookings and can still switch back to Mine when they need a personal view.

changes.h: Read visibility was mixed across endpoints
changes.was: Student requester scoping was applied to the combined list, checkout list, reservation list, change signal, and booking detail read.
changes.now: Internal Student reads are team-visible across those paths; collaborator privacy, own-only Student mutations, kiosk custody, and personal iOS Home scope remain separate.

verification: 76 focused route/native tests pass across booking lists, detail access, change signals, collaborator controls, sport boundaries, and iOS source contracts.
TypeScript, scoped ESLint, app build, docs verification, and iOS project registration pass.
Wisconsin Debug build passes for iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5; the matched before and after UI-test captures also pass.
Capture note: the first baseline runner wedged in Xcode's test finalizer and was stopped; a rerun with the exact booted device ID and clean derived data completed successfully.
notes: This slice changes authenticated web/native read visibility only. It does not deploy, run authenticated browser acceptance, or install the app on Erik's physical iPhone.
Students still receive actions only for bookings they own; collaborators remain private by default; iOS Home remains personal through scope=ios-home.
